title: AIAS Security and Recovery System
purpose: Protect governed AIAS assets and prove that verified backups can be safely restored within declared recovery objectives.
scope: Secret detection and exclusion, signed manifests, per-file integrity, safe restoration, automated recovery drills, RPO/RTO measurement and non-destructive retention planning.

requirements.title: Security exclusion
requirements.statement: Backups shall exclude forbidden secrets, key files, symbolic links and detected embedded credentials without disclosing values.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Signed integrity
requirements.statement: Every snapshot shall carry a caller-keyed HMAC manifest and SHA-256 digest for every included file.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Safe restoration
requirements.statement: Only verified safe members shall restore into an empty destination.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Recovery objectives
requirements.statement: RPO and RTO shall be explicit and evaluated from measured evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: A complete signed snapshot and automated restore drill shall recover reference AIAS project data.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Security and recovery shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
